Aurelian | Season, Terroir & Craft

The original prompt, shown as plain text. Select the text to copy it.

Prompt

Create an elegant, immersive website for a fine dining restaurant called "Aurelian" — a modern European restaurant with a focus on seasonal tasting menus, natural wines, and locally sourced ingredients. The design should feel luxurious, minimal, and editorial, with dramatic photography and generous whitespace.

1. NAVIGATION BAR
- Logo: "AURELIAN" in elegant spaced uppercase tracking (letter-spacing: 4px)
- Links: Menu, Wine, Our Story, Private Dining, Press, Reservations
- Right side: "Reserve a Table" CTA button (gold outline #C9A84C)
- Transparent over hero, transitions to solid black (#0F0F0F) on scroll
- Hamburger menu on mobile with full-screen dark overlay navigation

2. HERO SECTION (100vh full viewport)
- Full-bleed cinematic photo: an artfully plated dish on a dark table with dramatic side lighting, shallow depth of field
- Center-aligned text overlay:
  - "AURELIAN" in large spaced uppercase (font-size: 48px desktop)
  - Tagline: "Modern European Cuisine · Est. 2019"
  - Thin horizontal line divider (gold #C9A84C, 60px wide)
  - "A celebration of season, terroir, and craft"
- Two CTAs: "View Tasting Menu" (gold outline button) and "Reserve a Table" (solid gold button)
- Subtle slow Ken Burns effect on background image
- Scroll indicator arrow at bottom

3. PHILOSOPHY SECTION
- Dark background (#0F0F0F) with off-white text (#F5F0E8)
- Centered narrow column (max-width: 640px)
- Headline: "From Soil to Plate"
- Body text: "At Aurelian, every dish begins with the land. We work directly with local farmers, foragers, and fishermen within a 100-mile radius. Our kitchen transforms these ingredients through technique rooted in European tradition and refined with modern precision. The result is a menu that changes with the seasons — honest, beautiful, and deeply flavorful."
- Signature: "— Chef Marcus Aldridge"
- Decorative thin gold line accents above and below text

Design: Luxurious, minimal, editorial. Color palette: black (#0F0F0F), cream (#FAF8F3), off-white (#F5F0E8), gold (#C9A84C). Typography: Cormorant Garamond for headings (elegant serif), Montserrat Light for body (clean, refined). No rounded corners on cards — use sharp edges for sophistication. Thin gold line dividers between sections. Large whitespace, large typography. All text centered unless in split layouts. Photos should feel warm, moody, and cinematic with shallow depth of field.

Responsive: On mobile, all split layouts stack vertically. Menu items remain centered with comfortable spacing. Gallery becomes 2-column. Navigation becomes full-screen overlay. Reservation widget fields stack. Wine bottles scroll horizontally. Press quotes become vertical stack. Font sizes scale down but remain generous. Bottom sticky bar with "Reserve" CTA on mobile.
